notes.label: A
notes.critical_error: The VERDICT says Cactus delta-0 raises acceptance, but the source shows the opposite for DFlash2 at 10k and 50k (stock delta 0 acceptance is 0.3842 vs 0.5367 at delta 0.5 on 1.9.1, 10k), so a reader would credit stock delta 0 instead of the lossy delta 0.5 setting for the speed-up.

notes.label: B
notes.critical_error: The VERDICT says delta-0 gains speed only through longer acceptance, but the source shows delta 0.5 is the setting that raises acceptance and decode over stock delta 0 at 10k and 50k (1.9.1, 10k: DFlash2 91.02 vs 122.72 tok/s), so a reader would credit the stock setting instead of the lossy delta 0.5 for the speed-up.
